heading: A Land in Pieces
intro: You wake in a meadow at the edge of Aldermark with nothing but the clothes you stand in. The Triad that once kept the land whole has broken into shards, and something has taken the old tower on the northern rim. Nobody here will hand you a weapon, but somebody nearby might know where one is kept.

objectives.instruction: Look around the meadow and note the exits
Find a weapon: the hill to the west hides a cave with a hermit in it
Speak to the sage in the village green, north of the meadow
